subject: Colleen's Ice Cream Renovation and Reopening
overview: Medford Bytes hosts Danielle Balocca and Chelli Keshavan interviewed Colleen's Ice Cream and Sandwich Shop co-owners Kolin and Vicky Burgoyne. The owners discussed the shop's history in Medford Square, recent kitchen and dining room renovations, community pop-ups, and upcoming reopening plans.

items.title: Introductions and Local Medford Dining
items.summary: Danielle Balocca introduced co-owners Vicky and Kolin Burgoyne, who shared their favorite Medford dining spots including 4 Pizza, Deep Cuts Deli, Goldilocks Bagels, and Ebisuya.

items.title: History of Colleen's and Ownership Transition
items.summary: Kolin Burgoyne recounted starting work at Colleen's at age 15, the store's background as a former Brigham's location, and purchasing the business with Vicky in December 2018 upon the original owner's retirement.

items.title: Community Pop-Ups and Menu Favorites
items.summary: The owners discussed supporting local vendors through retail pop-ups and selling Mystic Coffee Roasters coffee, alongside their favorite sandwiches, soups, and frappes.

items.title: Renovations and Space Redesign
items.summary: The Burgoynes detailed an eight-week renovation that converted a semi-private dining area into an enclosed commercial kitchen, installed an expanded diner-style counter, and incorporated work from local artists.

items.title: Workplace Inclusivity and Staff Mentorship
items.summary: The owners discussed creating an inclusive environment for guests and staff, supporting youth employment, and fostering an open workplace culture.

items.title: Reopening Schedule and Wrap-Up
items.summary: Kolin Burgoyne announced plans to reopen on April 18 following final inspections, with regular operations running Tuesdays through Sundays.
